data.description: A vampiric mist drains blood with each melee touch attack dealing 1d3 points of Constitution damage.  Every time a vampiric mist damages a creature in this way, it heals 1d8 hit points.  Hit points healed in excess of its maximum are gained as temporary hit points, to a maximum of %1.  These temporary hit points last for 1 hour.
data.name: Blood Siphon
